title: Library: Reservations, Notifications, and Fine Policies
description: Add book reservations, email notifications, and configurable fine strategies.

data.text: Popular books have waitlists. Add reservation queues, notify members when books become available, and support configurable fine policies per member type.

data.title: ReservationQueue and FinePolicy
Why separate FinePolicy?
data.text: Different libraries have different fine rules. Some waive fines for staff, others double after 30 days. Strategy pattern lets each library configure its own policy without changing core checkout logic.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: ReservationQueue uses a FIFO queue per book ISBN
When a book is returned, check the queue and notify the next member
IFinePolicy allows per-member-type or per-library fine rules
Notify via INotificationService when reserved books become available
data.takeaway: Reservations and variable fine policies make the library feel like a real system. Decouple notification and policy logic from core domain objects.
